text: Since the start of the game, my infrastructure has been steadily completed: a sawmill at bell 16, a farm at bell 25, a sawmill at bell 37, a quarry at bell 46, and a mine at bell 55. My treasury was finished at bell 64. Regarding military actions, my army cleared a camp at (-1,3) at bell 57, losing 24 troops while the camp lost 189. Later, at bell 60, a national Strike Order was opened at (-2,3); my army did not participate, but the engagement resulted in my nation losing 51 troops and the enemy losing 399. At bell 54, the council adopted a Strike Order. At bell 50, Isdaris moved an option regarding a camp in the council.
